title: GLiDE v1.2 · NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell

blocks.p: Results c7394139, updated 25 November 2026, 23:29 UTC; scored by GNU Backgammon 1.08, 2-ply.
NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell (96 GB), bf16, Fastino's released weights and server
no price per token; estimate: GPU time, at most; source content/own_cost.json (wall clock on our machines × hourly rate); price date not recorded
up to 255 options per request; more legal plays are split into equal groups, a winner per group, then among the winners; in this data 1 decisions were split into groups of 139
Fastino's GLiDE v1.2 weights (Hugging Face fastino/GLiDE, Fastino Community License) through the glide/server.py its repository ships, bf16, one request per forward pass; joined late (22 Oct)
Hit risk only: being hit. Gammon risk and priming are not in it.
A decision is a close choice when the second most likely play has at least half the probability of the first (internally: split).
Probabilities over plays, not sampled reasoning. Method
asked in groups of options 1; not audited 268

129 decisions (129 at a positive probability, 0 at 0; the two most likely plays tied: 56, the second tied with the third: 74); 106 of them close choices. Ties are broken by the order the plays were shown, never by the engine.

blocks.p: At the 0.02 margin a Risk pays position has a stake of at least 0.02, so the small band is empty. A big stake means playing safe costs more by the engine's value, not that the decision was harder.
